text: Reddit repull 2026-10-31, two more threads at Alex request. (1) 1xif258 r/StableDiffusion "Need help finding an uncensored Prompt Visualizer for Minimax H3" (22 comments; Alex linked comment 19rv7151xjqv7 by xb1n0ry). Headline: NO dedicated H3 visualizer exists — every useful reply is an abliterated general LLM run with the official H3 prompt guide as system prompt, i.e. the same shape as our prompt_fix stage. Models named: darthcrawl/Lilith-31B-v1.0, 0bserverx/Qwen3.8-27B-Heretic-Abliterated-Uncensored-GGUF (both from the linked comment), huihui-abliterated Qwen 3.8 27B driven by the ComfyUI LM Studio node (loads, enhances, auto-ejects — our quiver discipline), qwen2.7-heretic q2 swapped to an RP gemma4 31b. FuckTheActualWhat system-prompt recipe: have Claude write the enhancer instruction against the target model official guide, then delete the censorship lines it inserts ("treating human bodies with dignity") and replace with be-explicit text. UNRESOLVED in thread: the H3-specific prompt-format node he uses comes from the "H3 seedhunter 2.5" workflow, name not recovered. Verified live on GitHub: duckyshell/ComfyUI-MiniMaxH3-Prompt-Writer (MIT, 294 stars, pushed 2026-10-28) is a ComfyUI UI EXTENSION, not a workflow node — Official/Compact writing contracts, modes T2VA/I2VA/FL2VA/L2VA/Reference, up to 9 images + 3 videos + 3 audio refs, providers Ollama/Direct GGUF/external llama.cpp/API, writes prompt text only (never queues H3). MiniMax-AI/MiniMax-H3 now ships skills/h3-prompt-writing/ (SKILL.md + agents/openai.yaml + references/base-en.txt 15773B + ref-en.txt 23553B); both references are md5-identical to our docs/h3-official guides, so only the wrapper was new — fetched to docs/h3-official/h3-prompt-writing_SKILL.md. xb1n0ry also announced an enhanced reference node with an automatic local-GGUF prompt writer, ETA tomorrow, NO link given — watch his GitHub. (2) 1xirbr2 r/comfyui, reached via share link /r/comfyui/s/zHwL2f8hD6 (resolved in browser; 137 score, 7 comments) = agentY, github.com/szprivate/agentY, MIT, 44 stars, pushed 2026-10-31: agent living inside ComfyUI, any LLM incl. local, builds unseen workflows, self-judges against the brief and re-renders misses, MCP presets for Blender/Maya/Houdini/AE, remotion editing, tagging + long-term memory, parallel agents, also packaged as an MCP. CAVEAT carried verbatim: commenter Hudz04 scanned the repo and labeled it MALICIOUS; the author does not dispute a mechanism, attributes the flag to the project being vibe-coded with code execution and points at the allowance gate. Do not install into the working ComfyUI tree without reading src/ and isolating it.
